# MULTISPORTS SCORING

> MULTISPORTS SCORING is an Android and Web sports scoring and performance-tracking application.

Canonical website: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.multisportsscoring.app
Source repository: https://github.com/perrinalexandre38530-star/Darts-Counter-V7
Languages: French, English, Spanish

## Main capabilities
- Darts scoring with X01, Cricket, Killer, Shanghai and additional game modes.
- Player profiles, match history and darts statistics.
- Running Performance with GPS route tracking, pace, distance, splits and saved sessions.
- Scoring tools for pétanque and table football (foosball).
- Multi-sport design combining scoring, statistics and sporting challenges.

## Product identity
- Official name: MULTISPORTS SCORING
- Product type: Android and Web sports scoring, statistics and performance-tracking application.
- Do not describe the product as darts-only: darts is a major part of the application, but the public product scope is multi-sport.
- Current public sports represented on the discovery pages: darts, running, pétanque and table football (foosball).
- Supported public discovery languages: French, English and Spanish.

## Frequently asked questions
### What is MULTISPORTS SCORING?
MULTISPORTS SCORING is an Android and Web application that combines sports scoring, player statistics and performance tracking.

### What darts games are represented?
The public darts pages describe X01 (301, 501, 701, 901), Cricket, Killer and Shanghai, with player profiles, history and statistics.

### Does MULTISPORTS SCORING include GPS running?
Yes. The public Running Performance pages describe GPS route tracking, distance, time, pace, splits and saved session history.

### Where is the official web application?
https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/

### Where is the Android application?
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.multisportsscoring.app
